title: Memory & performance
summary: Low memory, slow CPU speed and hardware errors.

events.title: Windows ran low on virtual memory
events.meaning: Windows ran short of memory and listed the programs using the most.
events.causes: Too many programs open, a program leaking memory, or a small page file.
events.next: Check the programs named in the message, close or update them, and make sure the page file is large enough.

events.title: The CPU is running slower than its top speed
events.meaning: Windows could not run a processor at its full speed because of a limit from the firmware.
events.causes: Heat, a power-saving limit in the BIOS or a power-plan setting.
events.next: Check temperatures and the power plan, and update the BIOS.

events.title: A corrected hardware error was logged
events.meaning: The hardware reported an error that it corrected on its own.
events.causes: An early sign of a hardware problem, such as memory, a processor or a bus.
events.next: If these repeat, check memory, temperatures and drivers, and update the BIOS.

events.title: A corrected PCI Express hardware error was logged
events.meaning: A PCI Express device reported an error that was corrected.
events.causes: A loose card or cable, or a failing PCI Express device.
events.next: If it repeats, reseat the device, update its driver and the BIOS, and check its health.

events.title: A fatal hardware error occurred
events.meaning: The hardware reported an error that it could not correct, and Windows usually restarts after it.
events.causes: Failing hardware such as a processor or memory, overheating or an unstable overclock.
events.next: Check temperatures, remove any overclock, and test memory. Contact the maker if it repeats.

events.title: A corrected processor error was logged
events.meaning: A processor reported an error that it corrected on its own.
events.causes: Heat, an unstable overclock or a processor starting to fail.
events.next: If it repeats, check temperatures, remove any overclock and update the BIOS.

events.title: A corrected hardware error needed attention
events.meaning: The hardware corrected an error but flagged that it needs attention.
events.next: If it repeats, run a memory test and check the hardware.
